mutants.defect: worker.py: the refusal branch tests `if data and refusal:` instead of `if not data and refusal:` - an empty reply that carries a refusal is no longer reported as a refusal, and a reply with real data plus refusal text is wrongly treated as refused.

bridge_concurrency_guard.py: the 'ended within window_s' test compares `age` (the call's age since it STARTED) instead of `now - ended[cid]` (time since it ENDED) - a long call that just ended is not seen as active, so the guard lets a foreign caller in right after it.
mutants.find: (cid in ended and now - ended[cid] <= window_s)

mutants.defect: northstar_site.py: the `os.chmod(dst, 0o666)` after copying the save was removed - a copy of a read-only source stays read-only, so the later overwrite/delete of the staged save fails (PermissionError on Windows).
Encasing.cs: `ingredients.Remove(ing);` was removed - the stack being encased stays in the ingredient list, so the job's ConsumeIngredients destroys it instead of encasing it.

RSW_CarbonFreezing.xml: the new bills WorkGiverDef (RSW_DoBillsCarbonFreezingPress) lists `RSW_CarbonFreezePress` in fixedBillGiverDefs, a def that does not exist (the press is `RSW_CarbonFreezingPress`) - no pawn ever works bills at the press (cross-reference error at load).

CompStorageClimate.cs partial-stasis inspect line: the two percentages passed to RM_ColdStorage_StasisHoldingPartial are swapped - it prints the spoil-rate factor as the field strength and (1 - factor) as the spoil rate, so a field holding at 80% reads 'holding at 20%, spoil at 80%' (the confusing message the item set out to fix).
RM_FlowKernel.cs IsLiveMouth: the neighbour loop runs `d < 3` instead of `d < 4` - the fourth cardinal direction is never checked, so a mouth open only on that side is wrongly judged dead.

FoodPoisonDisabledCookGuard.cs: the `!` before `StatDefOf.FoodPoisonChance.Worker.IsDisabledFor(pawn)` was dropped - the guard now skips exactly the cooks whose food-poison stat is disabled (the case it exists for) and acts on everyone else.

walk_gaps_proof.py tanks_verdict: compares `sum(u0) != sum(u1)` instead of the per-tank `u0 != u1` - fluid that moves between tanks with the total unchanged (levelling) is reported as no change, so the can-fail tank row cannot fail.
walk_gaps_proof.py tanks_verdict: the empty-tanks guard is `sum(u0) < 0` instead of `<= 0` - tanks that start empty are not reported UNMEASURED and go on to a meaningless PASS/FAIL.

modset_builder.py restore_before: the `os.remove(marker)` that consumes the restore marker was removed - the marker survives a successful restore, so a later --restore restores a stale snapshot again.
modset_builder.py main: a refused --restore (RestoreRefused) prints the refusal but returns exit code 0 instead of 1 - callers and scripts see success when nothing was restored.

publish.py rebase conflict handling: `not any(is_dll_pair_path(...))` instead of `not all(...)` - a conflict that mixes a DLL pair with ordinary source files is treated as DLL-only and auto-resolved (taking one side) instead of refusing.

mutants.replace: not any(is_dll_pair_path(p) for p in paths)

HoseMath.cs building-crossing count: the reused per-thread set `rigHitScratch` is no longer cleared (`hit.Clear()` dropped) before the walk - cells hit by earlier lays accumulate, so the returned crossing count grows from call to call instead of counting this pose's cells.
